title: Application crashes when uploading files larger than 100MB
body:
Steps to reproduce:
1. Go to web UI
2. Select 120MB CSV file
3. Click upload
4. Server responds with 500 error and crashes.

title: CSV file import memory leak in web client UI
body: When importing a large CSV file, memory usage grows continuously until the browser tab crashes. This happens during parsing in the web thread.

title: FastAPI backend returns 500 on large payload upload
body: The server crashes and throws a PayloadTooLarge exception when files exceed 100MB.

title: Add Excel xlsx file import support
body: Currently the application only supports CSV file uploads. We should add XLSX Excel file support to make it easier for users.

title: CSV export downloads are slow for large tables
body: Downloading reports takes too long. We should optimize the SQL queries used to build the CSV file before downloading.

title: Improve drag and drop file upload styling
body: The border of the dropzone is grey. It should highlight blue when a file is dragged over it.

title: Update installation guidelines for Windows in README
body: Add instructions on how to set up the environment variables on Windows systems using PowerShell.

title: How do I configure the server port?
body: I want to change the port from 8000 to 8080. Which configuration file should I edit?

title: Web UI file upload crashes
body: Uploading files crashes the web server instantly.

title: Large payload upload crashes during CSV validation
body: When uploading a large file, the CSV validator throws a schema mismatch error. The server stays up and returns a 400 Bad Request, not a 500 crash.
